items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: One of my friends, whom I've mentioned, the pianist, the pianist whom I've mentioned, a farmer. I especially liked Ruby Mae Townsend

ctx.x: What other piano players would you listen to about, at that time, around here?
One of my friends, whom I've mentioned, the pianist, the pianist whom I've mentioned, a farmer. I especially liked Ruby Mae Townsend, she was very good.
I've never heard of her, you know her, didn't she?
